Shadow <shadow42@erols.com> wrote:
>
>agent99@post.cz wrote:
>
>> Now, what is the most significant cultural
>> driving force toward globalism? 
> It is the
>> same force which drives the federal government
>> of the United States, in opposition to local
>> control.  It is the hammer that is being used,
>> worldwide, to flatten ethnic independence and
>> freedom of all sorts, including freedom to
>> publish on the internet.  It is PC, it is
>> leftism.
>
>Nope. It's greed and capitalism and the tendency of the rich/powerful to
>exploit everyone else. "Leftism" started out as a force that opposed the
>dominant ideology and attempted to restore justice to the poor, black
>people, etc.

How does greed and capitalism threaten to
censor the internet?  How does greed and
capitalism threaten the right of individuals
to associate with whom they want?  How does
greed and capitalism threaten the right of
an American own a firearm?  How did greed
and capitalism crush Serbian nationalism?
How do greed and capitalism threaten free
speech?

No, it is Jews who do all these things, 
not capitalists primarily, although some 
of these Jews may actually be greedy 
capitalists.  Plus, you must consider that
the Jew, with his obsessive concern with
money, is really the archetype of the
capitalist.  Capitalism, along with communism,
are two catastrophic economic systems 
produced by the negative influence of
the Jew on Western Culture.  Capitalism
is little else than usury developed to a
fine science; and usury is the specialty
of the Jew.

>
>  And who is behind these movements,
>> out of all proportion to their numbers in the
>> population?  The Jews, of course.  That is one
>> reason we are discussing them here.
>
>"Jews" as a group have nothing to do with the current state of our
>planet. Individually many capitalists & global megacorpocrats are Jews;
>many others are Japanese, German etc. Should we go after those
>nationalities as well? Get real. It's actions that count, not ethnic
>origins.

Yes, it is actions that count.  But if we count
the actions -- such as the actions of the Jewish 
cadre of communist leadership of the Soviet Union, 
which killed up to 60 million Gentiles; and the 
actions of the Jew-riddled criminal regime in 
Washington DC, in London, and other Western 
governments, which has been responsible for 
perpetrating war crimes and genocides against 
Serbia, Iraq, and other countries; and the actions
of the Israeli terror state, with its legally
sanctioned use of torture of Palestinian prisoners;
and the actions of Jew fifth-columnists, who
have infiltrated Western culture, and everywhere
purvey the most execrable filth and corruption,
and promote miscegenation and cultural destruction 
-- then we see that it is Jews who are primarily
to blame, alright.  Their Gentile lackeys are 
also equally guilty, however, and should suffer
the same fate as the Jews.

>
>> and their fairy tales -- including their ignoble
>> offspring Christianity -- have played a large
>> part in the history of Western Culture.  They
>> have plagued the races and cultures they have
>> parasitized for almost 3,000 years now. 
>
>Okay, I agree that Christianity (as practiced by white Europeans) has
>been a scourge on the planet. Can we go after those guys now?

Why blame the victim?  Christianity was a Jewish
invention.  All of the apostles were Jewish, the
theology is Jew-originated, and the central figure
is a Jew.  Certainly the gullible Gentiles who 
fell for such a pack of lies are reprehensible
in their own way.  But it makes more sense to 
blame the originators of the lies than those who
fell for them.

>
> Unless
>> we can obtain understanding of just WHY and HOW
>> the present crisis has come upon us, we have
>> no real hope of working our way out of it.
>
>The "present crisis" started with the Industrial Revolution. That's what
>our boy Ted says. I fail to see how persecuting Jews can reverse the
>ecological & social damages wrought by scientific progress. And if you

This is only one of a great many things you 
don't see.

>don't agree that that's what the crisis is, you don't belong in this
>newsgroup. The Unabomber may be crazy, homicidal etc, but he is not into
>racial/ethnic hatred.
>

That may or may not be true.  I see no strong 
evidence of that either way.  He says, for 
example:

"150. As we mentioned in paragraph 134,
industrial society seems likely to be
entering a period of severe stress,
due in part to problems of human
behavior and in part to economic and
environmental problems. And a
considerable proportion of the
system's economic and environmental
problems result from the way human
beings behave. Alienation, low
self-esteem, depression, hostility,
rebellion; children who won't study,
youth gangs, illegal drug use, rape,
child abuse, other crimes, unsafe sex,
teen pregnancy, population growth,
political corruption, race hatred,
ethnic rivalry, bitter ideological
conflict (i.e., pro-choice vs. pro-life),
political extremism, terrorism, sabotage,
anti-government groups, hate groups.
All these threaten the very survival of
the system. The system will be FORCED to
use every practical means of controlling
human behavior."

Since TK wants the system to break down,
it is not clear to me that he regards
such stresses on the industrial state as
an unqualified evil.  He may well have
thought, it seems to me, that in its death
throes the industrial state will be beset
with all of those stresses, and that they
may even be the proximate cause of the 
breakdown.

I also like my idea that TK meant, by 
walking a middle course, to alienate neither 
right nor left, but to USE them to achieve
his ends.  In fact, that's the best idea
I've seen in this forum in a while.  You
poor sods are lucky you've got me to do
your thinking for you. ;-)

As far as whom you do or do not approve of
posting here, it's a point of no concern 
to me at all.  Certainly people who reek
of political correctness, as do most of the
posters in this forum, are in no position to
accuse anyone on this ground.  If anyone is 
in conflict with TK's central thesis, it is 
such people.  Perhaps YOU should leave.  May
I suggest alt.cuddle?  

Hugs,
99

shickster; occ. shickser, shiksa, shikster, shickter.
[...]
2. Hence, any (Gentile) woman or girl: mostly Jewish and 
pej[orative]: late C.19-early 20 ... Adopted from Yiddish, it is 
the feminine form of Yiddish *sheggetz*, a Gentile man; 
*sheggetz* and, through it, *shicksa* come from the Hebrew 
*sheckets*, which means 'detestable thing' or ritually 'unclean 
animal' ... 3. A Gentile female servant: among Jews: late 
C.19-20.
--Eric Partridge, *Dictionary of Slang and Unconventional 
English*,  8th edn (New York: MacMillan, 1984), sv *shickster*.
